name: UnixPilot
description: Intelligent UNIX/Linux management agent for Claude Code. Safe, idempotent, FHS-compliant system administration.
longDescription:
UnixPilot is a Claude Code plugin that transforms your AI assistant into a Senior Linux Systems Engineer. It activates automatically on shell, dotfile, package, and system administration tasks — and enforces FHS standards, POSIX compliance, safety-first execution, and idempotent operations by default.

Features:
- Auto-activation on UNIX/Linux topics
- FHS-first path decisions
- POSIX-compliant by default
- Safety-enforced: dry-run + confirmation before destructive ops
- Idempotent operations
- GNU Stow dotfile management
- Cross-platform (Linux, macOS, BSD)
- System auto-detection

plugins.name: unixpilot
plugins.description: Senior Linux Systems Engineer agent. Activates on shell, dotfiles, packages, systemd, and sysadmin tasks.
